target: Neighbourhood DA false-negative: a timed-out/failed ePlanning DA lookup served as AUTHORITATIVE '0 nearby DAs'
findings_summary: get_nearby_das (generate_conveyancing_report.py:1654) swallows its own API exception and returns [], so _safe_call wraps it as DataField(value=[], AUTHORITATIVE); _build_neighbourhood (intelligence_brief.py:2252-53) then stamps AUTHORITATIVE 0 unconditionally. Fix: get_nearby_das must PROPAGATE failure (raise) so _safe_call yields NOT_AVAILABLE; _build_neighbourhood takes das_df and honours NOT_AVAILABLE (never AUTHORITATIVE 0 on a failed lookup); conveyancing CLI caller (3540) wraps in try/except to preserve its []-degrade. Two callers confirmed (brief + conveyancing PDF). No DB/schema/spatial change; pure error-propagation + confidence logic. Genuine empty result (no exception) stays AUTHORITATIVE 0, correctly.
